(1) Cherry-picks, with -x, from ae08-media-recovery: 59adf952 (src/hooks/useLocalTimelineMediaRecovery.ts: a reload superseded by a newer one waits for the newest reload while its guard still matches the mounted project and generation, so ensureMountedLocalMedia no longer sees an empty snapshot) and e7bbe58f (a reload whose guard names an unmounted project or generation returns before taking a version, so it cannot supersede the mounted generation's reload; a superseded caller waits until the newest queued reload has run; witness in useLocalTimelineMediaRecovery.test.ts, stale-reload test). useLocalTimelineMediaRecovery.test.ts 6 pass on 3 consecutive runs; src/hooks 730 pass, 2 skip, 2 fail (the 2 known HT reds); src/lib/local-control 65 pass; src/lib/timeline-repository 13 pass.

The hook mounts in an existing test file: src/components/timeline/create-persisted-automation-state.test.ts 'useTimelineAutomationController reloading unchanged effect data keeps the lanes workspace' mounts it on a shared project id (remote path, no IndexedDB), reloads an equal remoteEffects array and expects workspace().lanes to keep its identity, then a changed instance id and expects the new data. Red first: with the two `{ equals: sameData }` options removed the test fails ('Expected: {  Received: serializes to the same string'); restored, it passes. The hook is unchanged.

Parent ruling: retire it. The arm's expect moves to exit 0, 2 pass, 0 skip, 0 fail, no fails (as c0:m513-mutant-proj); tiers.ts retiredArms drops it and its control c0:m516-control-proj (listed in test-debt.md, with the row).
